_comment: Plain linear KV memory (2026-10-17): no clock, traces or STDP term. W <- (1 - eta) W + eta sum_t v k~^T (k~, q~: L2-normalized and learned 2D RoPE, as before), read q~ W^T. eta is learned per head (sigmoid), initialized at 0.0625 (16-block window, below B-EMA's 0.125). 8 blocks per segment, same harness as B-EMA.
